short_description: During his GTA 6 launch streams, IShowSpeed (real name Darren Watkins Jr.) teared up over a "Watkins Auto Parts" shop in the game. His dad reportedly called it the family's old company. Rockstar hasn't confirmed it's a nod to Speed, so for now it's his family's story. Background: official Rockstar gameplay footage, no streamer footage. More GTA 6 news: vicereplay.com
